selection_rules.calendar: Zero quantity is inserted for every calendar day from the first positive day through the last positive day of each selected series. The day is the invoice timestamp's calendar date, with no timezone conversion.
excluded: invoices whose code starts with C (cancellations)
negative quantities that are not cancellations (returns)
price missing or less than or equal to zero
quantity missing or less than or equal to zero

source.citation: Chen, Daqing. (2015). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
source.related_paper: Chen, D., Sain, S. L., and Guo, K. (2012). Data mining for the online retail industry: A case study of RFM model-based customer segmentation using data mining. Journal of Database Marketing and Customer Strategy Management, 19(3), 197-208.
